question: Which relaxing Yoga pose do we usually do at the very end of our practice by lying completely still? 🧘
explanation: Great job! Shavasana helps our body completely rest and relax after a good Yoga session. We lie on our back and keep very still! 🧘
hint: It involves lying flat on your back and resting.

question: What do we salute when we practice Surya Namaskar? ☀️
explanation: Awesome! Surya Namaskar means Sun Salutation. We do it to say thank you to the Sun for giving us light and energy! ☀️
hint: It shines bright in the daytime.

question: When is the best time of day to practice Surya Namaskar? 🌅
explanation: Super! The morning is the best time because the air is fresh and we can greet the rising sun! 🌅

question: How many total steps are there in one round of Surya Namaskar? 🔢
explanation: Perfect! Surya Namaskar is a beautiful flow of exactly 12 steps that stretches our whole body! 🔟
hint: It is the number after eleven.

question: How does our body feel after doing Surya Namaskar? ⚡
explanation: Great job! Stretching and breathing deeply gives our body lots of warm, happy energy! ⚡

question: In the first step of Surya Namaskar, what do we fold together? 🙏
explanation: Awesome! We fold our hands together in front of our chest in the Prayer pose! 🙏

question: Which Yoga pose makes us look like a snake lifting its head? 🐍
explanation: Super! Bhujangasana is the Cobra pose, where we lift our chest up just like a snake! 🐍

question: When doing Yoga, how should we take our breaths? 🫁
explanation: Excellent! Deep and slow breaths give our body more oxygen and help us stay calm! 🌬️

question: What do we do during Meditation (Dhyana) to help our mind? 🧘
explanation: Perfect! Meditation is sitting quietly and focusing our mind so we feel peaceful inside! 🧘

question: What happens to our busy mind when we meditate every day? 🕊️
explanation: Awesome! Sitting still helps quiet our thoughts, making our mind feel peaceful and calm! 🕊️

question: Where should we look when trying to balance on one leg in Tree Pose? 👁️
explanation: Great job! Staring at one still point helps our brain keep our body perfectly balanced! 🎯

question: Which sitting position looks like a beautiful flower and is good for meditation? 🪷
explanation: Super! Padmasana is called the Lotus pose. We sit cross-legged like a lovely lotus flower! 🪷
hint: A pink flower that grows in water.

question: How should our back be when we sit for meditation? 📏
explanation: Excellent! Keeping our spine straight helps our breath flow easily through our body! 📏

question: What gentle sound do we often chant to start or end Yoga? 🕉️
explanation: Perfect! Chanting 'Om' creates a happy vibration that relaxes our mind and body! 🕉️

question: Meditation helps us do what much better during class? 📚
explanation: Awesome! A calm mind helps us concentrate better, so we learn and remember things easily! 📚

question: What do we gently close when we are in deep meditation? 😌
explanation: Great job! Closing our eyes helps us look inside our mind instead of looking around the room! 😌

question: Where is the best place to practice Yoga and Meditation? 🌳
explanation: Super! A quiet and clean space helps us relax easily without any noisy distractions! 🌳

question: What is the Yoga word for breathing exercises? 🌬️
explanation: Excellent! Pranayama means controlling our breath to make our lungs very strong! 🌬️

question: Which body part fills up with air when we take a big breath in? 🫁
explanation: Perfect! Our lungs act like balloons, filling up with fresh air to keep us healthy! 🫁

question: How should we breathe in during Pranayama? 👃
explanation: Awesome! Breathing through our nose cleans the air before it goes into our body! 👃
hint: It is in the middle of your face.

question: Taking deep, slow breaths makes our mind feel...? 😌
explanation: Great job! Slow breathing tells our brain that we are safe, happy, and relaxed! 😌

question: What fun breathing exercise makes a humming sound like a bee? 🐝
explanation: Super! Bhramari Pranayama sounds just like a buzzing bee and feels tickly and nice! 🐝

question: If you ever feel upset or angry, what can you do to feel better? 🕊️
explanation: Excellent! Taking slow, deep breaths is a magical trick to wash the anger away! 🌬️

question: Deep breathing brings more of what good gas into our body? 🌟
explanation: Perfect! Our body needs fresh oxygen from the air to give us energy and keep us alive! 🌟

question: What is the correct name for the Yoga poses we do? 🧘
explanation: Awesome! Asanas are the special poses that make our body stretch and grow strong! 🧘

question: Which Yoga pose makes us stand tall and strong like a big hill? ⛰️
explanation: Great job! Tadasana is the Mountain pose where we stand very straight, firm, and tall! ⛰️
hint: A very high place made of rock.

question: Which pose teaches us to balance on one leg with our arms up? 🌳
explanation: Super! Vrikshasana is the Tree pose. It makes our legs strong like tree roots! 🌳

question: Doing Yoga every day makes our body very...? 🤸
explanation: Excellent! Stretching in Yoga helps our muscles bend easily like a bouncy rubber band! 🤸

question: Why is it important to stretch before doing harder Yoga poses? 🤸
explanation: Perfect! Warming up tells our muscles to get ready so they stay safe and happy! 🤸

question: When we bend down to touch our toes, we are doing a...? 🦶
explanation: Awesome! Forward bending is a great stretch for the back of our legs! 🦶

question: How should we move our body when going into a new Yoga pose? 🐢
explanation: Great job! Moving slowly helps us stay balanced and keeps our muscles safe from getting hurt! 🐢

question: What is the special mat called that we practice on? 🔲
explanation: Super! A Yoga mat gives us a soft and safe place so we don't slip while doing poses! 🔲
hint: It is named after the exercise.

question: What does the word 'Sadhana' mean in Yoga? 🎯
explanation: Excellent! Sadhana means our daily dedicated practice that makes us better and stronger! 🎯
hint: Doing something every day to improve.

question: Yoga is wonderful because it helps our body AND our...? 🧠
explanation: Perfect! Yoga connects our body and mind, making us strong on the outside and happy inside! 🧠
hint: The part of you that thinks.

question: What kind of clothes are best to wear for Yoga practice? 👕
explanation: Awesome! Loose and comfy clothes let our arms and legs move and stretch easily! 👕
hint: Soft and easy to move in.

question: Practicing Yoga teaches us to be what towards our own body? ❤️
explanation: Great job! Listening to our body and never pushing too hard is the Yoga way of being kind! ❤️

question: Practicing Surya Namaskar and Yoga every day keeps us...? 🍎
explanation: Super! Daily Yoga makes our heart, lungs, and muscles super strong and healthy! 🍎

question: While in Shavasana, what part of our body should be completely still? 🪨
explanation: Excellent! For the best relaxation, we let our whole body melt into the floor like a resting rock. 🪨

question: After a good Yoga Sadhana practice, we usually feel full of...? ✨
explanation: Perfect! Yoga fills us with bright, positive energy and makes us ready for a great day! ✨

question: How should we treat our Yoga mat? 🧹
explanation: Awesome! Rolling up our mat and keeping it clean shows respect for our Yoga practice. 🧹
hint: Wipe it and roll it nicely.

question: Which pose makes our back arch like an angry cat? 🐈
explanation: Great job! Marjaryasana is the Cat pose, it gives our back a very nice stretch! 🐈

question: In the 'Mountain Pose', our feet should be planted flat on the...? 🌍
explanation: Super! Pressing our feet flat on the floor helps us stand strong and grounded! 🌍

question: What is the main focus in Yoga Sadhana? 🎯
explanation: Excellent! Yoga is not a race; it is about finding peace and making ourselves better every day! 🧘

question: What should we do if a Yoga pose hurts? 🛑
explanation: Perfect! Yoga should never hurt. If it does, we gently stop and rest in a comfy pose! 🛑

question: When we reach our hands up in Surya Namaskar, what are we stretching? 💪
explanation: Awesome! Reaching up high stretches our arms, back, and belly all at once! 💪
hint: From your toes to your fingers.

question: What does closing our eyes in meditation help us see? 💖
explanation: Great job! Closing our eyes helps us look inside our heart and mind to find quietness. 💖

question: Yoga makes our muscles feel super...? 💪
explanation: Super! Holding poses like a Tree or a Mountain builds strong and healthy muscles! 💪

question: Which of these is a great reason to do Yoga? 🌟
explanation: Excellent! Yoga is one of the best ways to keep our body and brain super healthy! 🌟

question: How do we feel when we finish singing the 'Om' sound? 😌
explanation: Perfect! The vibration from 'Om' spreads a calm, peaceful feeling all over our body! 😌

question: What should we say to our teacher after our Yoga class? 🙏
explanation: Awesome! Saying 'Namaste' shows love and respect to our teacher and our friends! 🙏
hint: A respectful greeting with folded hands.
